                q = [(r, c)]

def connected_components(arr, target):
    h, w = arr.shape

    components = []

            if arr[r, c] == target and (r, c) not in visited:

                queue = [(r, c)]
                while queue:
                    curr = queue.pop(0)
                    if curr in visited:

                    visited.add(curr)
                    comp.add(curr)
                    for dr in [-1, 0, 1]:

                components.append(comp)
